unitTitle: See New Places, Meet New Faces

exercises.instructionEn: Use your answers from Ex. 4 to talk about LA.
exercises.instructionUz: LA haqida gapirish uchun 4-mashqdagi javoblaringizdan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
83-betdagi 4b-mashqda besh savolga javob berdingiz.
Endi o'sha javoblarni BIRLASHTIRIB, LA haqida
og'zaki hikoya qiling.

TUZILISh (maqolaning bo'limlari tartibida):

  1  Kirish
     'Los Angeles is the second largest city in America.
      It's home to film stars, sunny weather, tall
      buildings and heavy traffic.'

  2  Mehmonxonalar (ACCOMMODATION)
     'You can stay at The Biltmore or The Omni ...'

  3  Ko'riladigan joylar (SIGHTS)
     'There are many interesting places you can visit,
      like Venice Beach ...'

  4  Restoranlar (RESTAURANTS)
     'You can eat at the Buffalo Club ...'

  5  Do'konlar (SHOPS)
     'You can go shopping on Melrose Avenue ...'

  6  Tungi hayot (NIGHTLIFE)
     'The nightlife is exciting on the Sunset Strip ...'

  7  Xulosa
     'LA is a modern city with something for everyone.
      It's noisy and crowded, but it's also
      fascinating.'


FOYDALI BOG'LOVChI IBORALAR:
  First of all, ...      = Avvalambor, ...
  What's more, ...       = Bundan tashqari, ...
  Also, ...              = Shuningdek, ...
  Finally, ...           = Nihoyat, ...
  All in all, ...        = Umuman olganda, ...

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  film, heavy, 24-hour, sunny, designer,
  famous, expensive, make

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SUNNY weather        (quyoshli ob-havo)
  2  HEAVY traffic        (zich transport oqimi)
  3  EXPENSIVE shops      (qimmat do'konlar)
  4  FILM stars           (kino yulduzlari)
  5  to MAKE films        (film suratga olmoq)
  6  DESIGNER clothes     (dizayner kiyimlar)
  7  24-HOUR cafes        (24 soat ishlaydigan kafelar)
  8  FAMOUS restaurants   (mashhur restoranlar)


HAMMASI 83-BETDAGI MAQOLADAN:
  'sunny weather, tall buildings and heavy traffic'
  'the EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive'
  'It's also home to FILM STARS'
  'Universal Studios to see how they MAKE FILMS'
  'Do you want DESIGNER CLOTHES?'
  '24-HOUR CAFES like Van Go's Ear'
  'There are FAMOUS RESTAURANTS you can eat at'


DIQQAT — 5-BAND BOShQAChA:
  Ro'yxatdagi 7 ta so'z SIFAT yoki OT,
  faqat 'make' — FE'L.
  Bo'shliqdan oldin 'to' turgani shuni ko'rsatadi:
  'TO ...... films' → 'TO MAKE films'.

DIQQAT — '24-HOUR' YOZILIShI:
  Sifat sifatida ishlatilganda 'hour' KO'PLIK
  BO'LMAYDI: '24-hour cafes' ('24-hours' XATO).
  Xuddi shunday: 'a five-minute walk',
  'a ten-year-old boy'.

DIQQAT — 'FILM STARS' va 'DESIGNER CLOTHES':
  Bu yerda birinchi so'z OT bo'lsa ham,
  SIFAT vazifasini bajaradi (ot + ot birikmasi).

DIQQAT — 'HEAVY' NING MA'NOSI:
  'heavy' = og'ir. Lekin 'heavy traffic' = zich
  transport oqimi (og'ir transport EMAS).
  Shuningdek: 'heavy rain' = kuchli yomg'ir.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Ob-havo haqidagi yagona sifat — SUNNY.
Maqola: 'sunny weather'.
'sunny' = quyoshli (sun + -ny).

'HEAVY traffic' — turg'un birikma.
Maqola: 'tall buildings and heavy traffic'.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'heavy' = ZICH, og'ir emas.

Maqola: 'go to the EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive'.
'expensive' = qimmat.

'FILM stars' = kino yulduzlari.
Maqola: 'It's also home to film stars'.
DIQQAT: 'film' bu yerda OT, lekin SIFAT
vazifasini bajaradi.

Bo'shliqdan oldin 'TO' turibdi →
FE'L kerak. Ro'yxatdagi yagona fe'l — MAKE.
Maqola: 'Universal Studios to see how they MAKE
FILMS'.
DIQQAT: ingliz tilida 'MAKE a film' deyiladi
('do a film' EMAS).

Maqola: 'Do you want DESIGNER CLOTHES?'
'designer clothes' = mashhur dizayner yaratgan,
qimmat kiyimlar.
83-betdagi C rasmi.

Maqola: '24-HOUR CAFES like Van Go's Ear'.
= 24 soat, tunu kun ishlaydigan kafelar.
DIQQAT: sifat sifatida 'hour' KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI.

Maqola: 'There are FAMOUS restaurants you can
eat at'.
82-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi ham shu edi.
'famous' = mashhur.

exercises.instructionEn: Then use them to make sentences.
exercises.explanationUz:
Sakkiz birikmaning har biridan BITTA gap tuzing.

NAMUNA GAPLAR:

modelSentences.sentence: LA has sunny weather all year round.
modelSentences.uz: LA da yil bo'yi quyoshli ob-havo bo'ladi.

modelSentences.sentence: There is heavy traffic on the roads in LA.
modelSentences.uz: LA yo'llarida zich transport oqimi bor.

modelSentences.sentence: There are expensive shops on Rodeo Drive.
modelSentences.uz: Rodeo-Drayvda qimmat do'konlar bor.

modelSentences.sentence: Many film stars live in Hollywood.
modelSentences.uz: Ko'plab kino yulduzlari Gollivudda yashaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: You can see how they make films at Universal Studios.
modelSentences.uz: 'Universal Studios' da filmlarni qanday suratga olishlarini ko'rishingiz mumkin.

modelSentences.sentence: You can buy designer clothes on Rodeo Drive.
modelSentences.uz: Rodeo-Drayvda dizayner kiyimlar sotib olishingiz mumkin.

modelSentences.sentence: 24-hour cafes are popular with visitors.
modelSentences.uz: 24 soat ishlaydigan kafelar sayyohlar orasida mashhur.

modelSentences.sentence: There are famous restaurants you can eat at in LA.
modelSentences.uz: LA da ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: of, in, at, to, with, on
exercises.instructionUz: To'ldiring: of, in, at, to, with, on
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI PREDLOG, 10 ta bo'shliq —
demak ba'zilari BIR NEChA marta ishlatiladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  the second largest city IN America
   2  it's home TO film stars
   3  close TO special bus-stops
   4  footprints OF film stars
   5  you can get rides TO the various sights
   6  eat AT a restaurant
   7  packed WITH celebrities
   8  IN the world
   9  ON Rodeo Drive
  10  popular WITH visitors


QAYSI PREDLOG NECHA MARTA:
  TO   — 3 marta (2, 3, 5)
  IN   — 2 marta (1, 8)
  WITH — 2 marta (7, 10)
  OF   — 1 marta (4)
  AT   — 1 marta (6)
  ON   — 1 marta (9)


QOIDALAR:

  IN + katta joy (mamlakat, shahar, dunyo)
     in America, in the world, in Tashkent

  ON + ko'cha, avenyu
     on Rodeo Drive, on Melrose Avenue
     DIQQAT: 'in' EMAS!

  AT + aniq nuqta (bino, muassasa)
     at a restaurant, at a hotel, at school

  TO + yo'nalish yoki yaqinlik
     home TO ... (makoni)
     close TO ... (yaqin)
     rides TO ... (qayerga)

  OF + egalik / tegishlilik
     footprints OF film stars

  WITH + birgalik yoki to'lganlik
     packed WITH, popular WITH


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR:
  be home TO ...     = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq
  close TO ...       = ... ga yaqin
  packed WITH ...    = ... bilan to'lib ketgan
  popular WITH ...   = ... orasida mashhur

commonMistake.whyUz:
MAMLAKAT bilan IN.
'in America', 'in Uzbekistan'.

'be home TO ...' — turg'un birikma
(... ning makoni bo'lmoq).
DIQQAT: 'home OF' EMAS.

'close TO ...' — turg'un birikma (... ga yaqin).
DIQQAT: 'close FROM' XATO.

EGALIK: kimning izlari? → film stars NING.
'OF' egalikni bildiradi.

items.sentence: 5  you can get rides ........ the various sights

commonMistake.whyUz:
YO'NALISh: qayerga? → sights GA.
'a ride TO ...' = ... ga yo'l/sayohat.

'eat AT a restaurant' — muassasa bilan AT.
83-betdagi maqola: 'eat AT the Border Grill'.
DIQQAT: 'eat IN a restaurant' ham aytiladi,
lekin kitob 'at' shaklini o'rgatadi.

'packed WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... bilan to'lib ketgan).
TO'LGANLIK har doim WITH bilan.

'IN the world' — turg'un birikma.
Maqola: 'one of the most exciting museums IN THE
WORLD'.
ORTTIRMA daraja bilan doim 'in' yoki 'of'.

KO'ChA bilan ON.
'ON Rodeo Drive', 'ON Melrose Avenue'.
DIQQAT: 'in Rodeo Drive' XATO.

'popular WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... orasida mashhur).
DIQQAT: 'popular AMONG' ham to'g'ri, lekin
kitob 'with' shaklini beradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIM — bir xil ma'noli boshqa so'z.

RO'YXAT (6 ta):
  district, not dangerous, memorable, well-known,
  interesting, near

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  safe          =  NOT DANGEROUS
  2  close         =  NEAR
  3  fascinating   =  INTERESTING
  4  famous        =  WELL-KNOWN
  5  unforgettable =  MEMORABLE
  6  area          =  DISTRICT


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  safe (xavfsiz) = not dangerous (xavfli emas)
     'dangerous' ning INKORI.
     Maqola: 'they are clean and SAFE'.

  close (yaqin) = near (yaqin)
     Ikkalasi ham masofani bildiradi.
     DIQQAT: 'close' predlogi TO,
     'near' esa predlogsiz: 'near the school'.

  fascinating (maftunkor) = interesting (qiziqarli)
     'fascinating' — kuchliroq shakl.
     Maqola oxiri: 'but it's also FASCINATING'.

  famous (mashhur) = well-known (yaxshi tanilgan)
     'well-known' = well + known (chiziqcha bilan).

  unforgettable (unutilmas) = memorable (esda qolarli)
     'memorable' — 'memory' (xotira) dan.
     'unforgettable' — un + forget + able.

  area (hudud) = district (tuman, hudud)
     Maqola: 'the Sunset Strip, an AREA in Hollywood'.


NIMANI O'RGATADI:
  Bir gapni turlicha aytish mumkin:
     'The hotels are safe.'
     'The hotels are not dangerous.'
  Yozishda TAKRORDAN qochish uchun sinonimlar
  kerak bo'ladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'safe' = xavfsiz.
'not dangerous' = xavfli emas.
Yagona INKOR shaklidagi variant.

Ikkalasi ham 'yaqin'.
DIQQAT: 'close TO the shop' (predlog bilan),
'NEAR the shop' (predlogsiz).

'fascinating' = maftunkor —
'interesting' ning KUChLIROQ shakli.
82-betdagi 3-mashqda ham 'interesting places'.

'well-known' = yaxshi tanilgan, mashhur.
Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.
5-mashqning 8-bandi: 'famous restaurants'.

'memorable' = esda qolarli ('memory' dan).
'unforgettable' = un + forget + able = unutilmas.
Maqola: 'A visit there is always UNFORGETTABLE.'

Ikkalasi ham 'hudud'.
Maqola: 'the Sunset Strip, an AREA in Hollywood'.
'district' — ko'proq shahar ichidagi tuman.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then say how we form the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing, so'ng sifatlarning qiyosiy va orttirma darajalari qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — TO'LIQ:

 ┌──────────────┬───────────┬───────────────┬──────────────────┐
 │              │ adjective │  comparative  │   superlative    │
 │              │  (sifat)  │   (qiyosiy)   │    (orttirma)    │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ BIR BO'G'INLI│  cheap    │  cheapER      │ THE cheapEST     │
 │   sifatlar   │  large    │  largER       │ THE largEST      │
 │              │  big      │  bigGER       │ THE bigGEST      │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ -Y bilan     │  noisy    │  noisIER      │ THE noisIEST     │
 │  tugaganlar  │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ IKKI yoki    │ expensive │ MORE expensive│ THE MOST         │
 │ undan ko'p   │           │               │  expensive       │
 │  bo'g'inli   │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │              │  good     │  better       │ THE best         │
 │  NOTO'G'RI   │  bad      │  worse        │ THE worst        │
 │   sifatlar   │ much/many │  more         │ THE most         │
 │              │  little   │  less         │ THE least        │
 └──────────────┴───────────┴───────────────┴──────────────────┘


QOIDALAR — TO'RT GURUH:

1) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  sifat + -ER
   orttirma: THE + sifat + -EST

   MAXSUS HOLATLAR:
     • '-e' bilan tugasa → faqat -R / -ST
        large → largER → the largEST
        safe  → safER  → the safEST
     • BITTA unli + BITTA undosh bilan tugasa →
       oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI
        big → bigGER → the bigGEST
        hot → hotTER → the hotTEST
        fat → fatTER → the fatTEST

2) '-Y' bilan tugagan sifatlar
   '-y' tushadi, '-IER' / '-IEST' qo'shiladi
     noisy  → noisIER  → the noisIEST
     easy   → easIER   → the easIEST
     happy  → happIER  → the happIEST
     dirty  → dirtIER  → the dirtIEST

3) IKKI va undan KO'P BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  MORE + sifat
   orttirma: THE MOST + sifat
     expensive → MORE expensive → THE MOST expensive
     modern    → MORE modern    → THE MOST modern
     beautiful → MORE beautiful → THE MOST beautiful

4) NOTO'G'RI sifatlar — YODLASh kerak
     good        → better → the best
     bad         → worse  → the worst
     much / many → more   → the most
     little      → less   → the least

   DIQQAT: 'gooder', 'baddest', 'more good' —
   HAMMASI XATO.


ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
  ✗ more cheaper    ✓ cheaper
  ✗ more noisier    ✓ noisier
  ✗ the most oldest ✓ the oldest
  ✗ gooder          ✓ better
  ✗ cheapest city   ✓ THE cheapest city

  ASOSIY QOIDA: -ER/-EST va MORE/MOST ni
  BIRGA ishlatib bo'lmaydi.
  ORTTIRMA daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.

points.en: one-syllable adjectives: cheap → cheaper → the cheapest
points.uz: bir bo'g'inli sifatlar: arzon → arzonroq → eng arzon

points.en: large → larger → the largest
big → bigger → the biggest
points.noteUz:
BITTA unli + BITTA undosh →
oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI (big → bigGer).

points.en: -y adjectives: noisy → noisier → the noisiest
points.uz: -y bilan tugagan sifatlar: shovqinli → shovqinliroq → eng shovqinli

points.en: adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive
points.uz: ikki yoki undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar: qimmat → qimmatroq → eng qimmat
points.noteUz:
MORE va THE MOST bilan.
'expensiver' XATO.

points.en: irregular: good → better → the best
irregular: bad → worse → the worst
irregular: much / many → more → the most
points.noteUz:
'much' SANALMAYDIGAN ot bilan,
'many' SANALADIGAN ot bilan.
Qiyosiy shakli ikkalasi uchun bir xil: MORE.

points.en: irregular: little → less → the least

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — TO'RT QOIDA:


1) QIYOSIY DARAJA (comparative form)
   IKKI odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   Odatda 'THAN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Parthenon is OLDER THAN the Colosseum.'
     (Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq.)


2) ORTTIRMA DARAJA (superlative form)
   IKKIDAN KO'P odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Great Pyramid of Cheops is THE OLDEST OF ALL.'
     (Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski.)


3) (NOT) AS + sifat + AS
   Ikki narsani TENGLIK bo'yicha solishtiradi.

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford-upon-Avon ISN'T AS NOISY AS LA.'
     (Stratford LA-chalik shovqinli emas.)

   DIQQAT — IKKI XIL MA'NO:
     'A is AS big AS B'      = A B chalik katta (TENG)
     'A ISN'T AS big AS B'   = A B chalik katta emas
                               (A kichikroq)

   DIQQAT: 'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY
   shakli qo'yiladi ('as noisier as' XATO).


4) MUCH + qiyosiy daraja
   Farqni KUChAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford is MUCH QUIETER than LA.'
     (Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq.)

   DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan,
   oddiy sifat bilan EMAS ('much quiet' XATO).


BETDAGI UCh TARIXIY YODGORLIK (rasmlarda):

  The Great Pyramid of Cheops  —  2465 BC (m.a.)
     Misrdagi Xeops piramidasi — ENG ESKI

  The Parthenon                —  438 BC (m.a.)
     Afinadagi Parfenon ibodatxonasi — o'rtada

  The Colosseum                —  82 AD (milodiy)
     Rimdagi Kolizey — ENG YANGI

  'BC' = Before Christ = miloddan avvalgi
  'AD' = Anno Domini   = milodiy

  DIQQAT — SANALARNI TAQQOSLASh:
  'BC' sanalarida son KATTA bo'lsa,
  vaqt UZOQROQ (eskiroq).
  2465 BC > 438 BC → piramida Parfenondan ESKIROQ.


ShU UCh YODGORLIK BILAN GAPLAR:
  The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum.
  The Great Pyramid is older than the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all.
  The Colosseum is the newest of the three.
  The Colosseum isn't as old as the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid is much older than the Colosseum.

points.en: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives.
points.uz: Qiyosiy darajani IKKI odam, narsa, joyni solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. Odatda 'than' bilan.

points.en: The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum.
points.noteUz:
Parfenon — 438 BC, Kolizey — 82 AD.
Parfenon ancha oldin qurilgan.

points.en: We use the superlative form to compare more than two people, things, places etc. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives.
points.uz: Orttirma darajani IKKIDAN KO'P odam, narsa, joyni solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. 'the ... of/in' bilan.
points.noteUz:
UCh yoki undan ko'p → ORTTIRMA daraja.
DOIM 'THE' bilan.

points.en: The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all.
points.noteUz:
2465 BC — uchtasining eng eskisi.
'the oldest OF all' — 'of' bilan.

points.en: We can also use (not) as + adjective + as to compare two places, things, people, etc.
points.uz: Shuningdek '(not) as + sifat + as' ni ikki joy, narsa, odamni solishtirish uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin.

points.en: Stratford-upon-Avon isn't as noisy as LA.
points.noteUz:
= LA Stratforddan shovqinliroq.
Bir fikrni ikki xil aytish mumkin.

points.en: We use much + comparative degree.
points.noteUz:
Farqni KUCHAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').
'much quiet' XATO — faqat qiyosiy daraja bilan.

points.en: Stratford is much quieter than LA.
The Great Pyramid of Cheops (2465 BC) — The Parthenon (438 BC) — The Colosseum (82 AD)
points.noteUz:
BC = miloddan avvalgi, AD = milodiy.
BC sanasi KATTA bo'lsa — ESKIROQ.
Eng eskisi: piramida. Eng yangisi: Kolizey.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the underlined adjectives in the article about LA, then make a table and complete the missing forms, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: LA haqidagi maqoladagi tagi chizilgan sifatlarga qarang, so'ng jadval tuzing va yetishmayotgan shakllarni to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA JADVALI:

 ┌───────────┬─────────────┬────────────────┐
 │ adjective │ comparative │  superlative   │
 ├───────────┼─────────────┼────────────────┤
 │  large    │  larger     │  the largest   │
 │  sunny    │  sunnier    │  the sunniest  │
 └───────────┴─────────────┴────────────────┘

83-betdagi maqolada tagi chizilgan sifatlar
asosida jadvalni davom ettiring.


TO'LIQ JADVAL — MAQOLADAGI HAMMA SIFAT:

  BIR BO'G'INLI (-ER / THE -EST):
    large   →  larger   →  the largest      (NAMUNA)
    tall    →  taller   →  the tallest
    clean   →  cleaner  →  the cleanest
    cheap   →  cheaper  →  the cheapest
    old     →  older    →  the oldest
    safe    →  safer    →  the safest

  -Y BILAN TUGAGAN (-IER / THE -IEST):
    sunny   →  sunnier  →  the sunniest     (NAMUNA)
    noisy   →  noisier  →  the noisiest
    heavy   →  heavier  →  the heaviest
    lovely  →  lovelier →  the loveliest

  IKKI VA UNDAN KO'P BO'G'INLI (MORE / THE MOST):
    expensive     →  more expensive
                  →  the most expensive
    interesting   →  more interesting
                  →  the most interesting
    exciting      →  more exciting
                  →  the most exciting
    famous        →  more famous
                  →  the most famous
    delicious     →  more delicious
                  →  the most delicious
    fashionable   →  more fashionable
                  →  the most fashionable
    unforgettable →  more unforgettable
                  →  the most unforgettable
    modern        →  more modern
                  →  the most modern
    crowded       →  more crowded
                  →  the most crowded
    fascinating   →  more fascinating
                  →  the most fascinating
    popular       →  more popular
                  →  the most popular


DIQQAT — MAQOLADA ALLAQAChON ISHLATILGANLARI:
  'the second LARGEST city'
  'MORE EXPENSIVE than'
  'one of THE MOST EXCITING museums'
  'Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant'
  'THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes'


DIQQAT — 'SAFE' VA 'LARGE':
  '-e' bilan tugagani uchun faqat -R va -ST:
     safe  → safER  → the safEST
     large → largER → the largEST

DIQQAT — 'LOVELY':
  '-ly' bilan tugasa ham bu SIFAT (ravish emas),
  shuning uchun '-y' qoidasiga bo'ysunadi:
     lovely → lovelIER → the lovelIEST

items.whyUz:
Bir bo'g'inli, '-e' bilan tugagan →
faqat -R va -ST.
Maqolada: 'the second LARGEST city'.

'-y' tushadi → heavIER / the heavIEST.
Maqolada: 'HEAVY traffic'.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada allaqachon: 'MORE EXPENSIVE than those
in many other American cities'.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
Maqolada: 'they are CLEAN and safe'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the adjectives in the list to compare LA with the place you live in.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib LA ni o'zingiz yashaydigan joy bilan solishtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (13 ta sifat):
  large, clean, noisy, polluted, crowded, small, dirty,
  safe, expensive, old, modern, peaceful, cheap

KITOBDAGI BESh NAMUNA — TO'RT XIL QOLIP:

  1  LA is LARGER THAN my town.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN

  2  My town is CLEANER THAN LA.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN (teskari yo'nalishda)

  3  LA is MUCH NOISIER THAN my town.
     → MUCH + qiyosiy daraja (kuchaytirish)

  4  My town is AS NOISY AS LA.
     → AS + oddiy sifat + AS (tenglik)

  5  My town ISN'T AS POLLUTED AS LA.
     → ISN'T AS + oddiy sifat + AS (inkor)


BARCHA 13 SIFAT BILAN NAMUNA GAPLAR
(o'z shahringiz nomini qo'ying):

   large     — LA is larger than my town.
   clean     — My town is cleaner than LA.
   noisy     — LA is much noisier than my town.
   polluted  — My town isn't as polluted as LA.
   crowded   — LA is more crowded than my town.
   small     — My town is smaller than LA.
   dirty     — LA is dirtier than my town.
   safe      — My town is safer than LA.
   expensive — LA is much more expensive than my town.
   old       — My town is older than LA.
   modern    — LA is more modern than my town.
   peaceful  — My town is more peaceful than LA.
   cheap     — My town is cheaper than LA.


QAYSI SIFAT QANDAY YASALADI:

  -ER oladiganlar (bir bo'g'inli):
     large → larger,  small → smaller,
     safe  → safer,   old   → older,
     clean → cleaner, cheap → cheaper

  -IER oladiganlar ('-y' bilan tugagan):
     noisy → noisier,  dirty → dirtier

  MORE oladiganlar (uzun):
     polluted  → more polluted
     crowded   → more crowded
     expensive → more expensive
     modern    → more modern
     peaceful  → more peaceful


DIQQAT — 'MUCH MORE EXPENSIVE':
  'much' + 'more expensive' — ikkalasi birga
  KELISHI mumkin, chunki 'more expensive' —
  bitta qiyosiy shakl, 'much' esa uni kuchaytiradi.

DIQQAT — QARAMA-QARShI JUFTLIKLAR RO'YXATDA:
  large ↔ small        clean ↔ dirty
  noisy ↔ peaceful     expensive ↔ cheap
  old   ↔ modern
  Har juftlikning BIRINI tanlab, gapni
  ikki xil aytish mumkin:
     'LA is larger than my town.'
     'My town is smaller than LA.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL.

YANGI SO'Z:
  peaceful = tinch, osoyishta
             ('peace' — tinchlik dan)

wordFormation.introUz: 84-bet — Unit 12 ning asosiy grammatikasi: qiyosiy va orttirma daraja.

groups.ruleUz: QOIDA 3 — IKKI+ BO'G'IN: MORE / THE MOST

groups.explanationUz: Bir xil ma'noli so'zlar — takrordan qochish uchun.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 84-betdagi to'rt qiyoslash qolipi — Unit 12 ning eng muhim qismi.

patterns.formula: A is [sifat]-ER / MORE [sifat] THAN B.   (IKKI narsa)
patterns.exampleEn: The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum. LA is more expensive than my town.
patterns.exampleUz: Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq. LA mening shahrimdan qimmatroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY daraja — IKKITA narsani solishtiradi.
Doim 'THAN' bilan.
Qisqa sifat → -ER, uzun sifat → MORE.

patterns.formula: A is THE [sifat]-EST / THE MOST [sifat] OF/IN ... .   (IKKIDAN KO'P)
patterns.exampleEn: The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all. It's one of the most exciting museums in the world.
patterns.exampleUz: Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski. Bu dunyodagi eng qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.
patterns.explanationUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja — IKKIDAN KO'P narsani solishtiradi.
DOIM 'THE' bilan.
'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN'.

patterns.formula: A is AS [oddiy sifat] AS B.   /   A ISN'T AS [oddiy sifat] AS B.
patterns.exampleEn: My town is as noisy as LA. Stratford-upon-Avon isn't as noisy as LA.
patterns.exampleUz: Mening shahrim LA-chalik shovqinli. Stratford LA-chalik shovqinli emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
TENGLIK qolipi.
'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli
('as noisier as' XATO).
Inkor shakli — A ning B dan KAM ekanini bildiradi.

patterns.formula: A is MUCH + [qiyosiy daraja] THAN B.
patterns.exampleEn: Stratford is much quieter than LA. LA is much more expensive than my town.
patterns.exampleUz: Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq. LA mening shahrimdan ancha qimmatroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
'much' farqni KUCHAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan ('much quiet' XATO).

patterns.formula: ot + ot birikmasi (birinchi ot SIFAT vazifasida)
patterns.exampleEn: film stars, designer clothes, 24-hour cafes, bus-stops
patterns.exampleUz: kino yulduzlari, dizayner kiyimlar, 24 soatlik kafelar, avtobus bekatlari
patterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi ot KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI:
'24-hour cafes' ('24-hours' XATO),
'film stars' ('films stars' XATO).
